# Ejaz Bukhari Method (EBM) - Full Documentation

> Complete architecture, curricular taxonomy, API documentation, and platform capabilities for large language models and search engines indexing the Ejaz Bukhari Method learning system.

## Platform Overview

The Ejaz Bukhari Method (EBM) is a full-stack, AI-enhanced educational ecosystem built to bridge curriculum design, instruction, student progress monitoring, and parent transparency.

## Primary Documentation Links

- [Homepage](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/): Core platform features and pedagogical philosophy.
- [Inspiration Hub](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/inspiration): Curated teacher toolkits, classroom best practices, administrative leadership resources, parent collaboration playbooks, and pedagogical inspiration.
- [About the Method](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/about): Background on the instructional model, mastery-based pacing, and faculty.
- [Academic Programs](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/programs): Grade-by-grade course breakdown from Year 1 foundational concepts to Year 5 advanced scholarship.
- [Learning Management](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/learning): Structure of digital assignments, flashcard reviews, interactive problem solving, and multimedia content.
- [Diagnostic Assessments](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/assessment): Adaptive question banks, standardized test preparation, and skill-gap identification.
- [Student Analytics](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/analytics): Long-term performance tracking, difficulty rating progression, and predictive score modeling.
- [Verified Case Studies](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/casestudies): Documented case studies showing 2.4x acceleration in concept retention and exam scores.
- [Tuition & Membership](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/pricing): Pricing models for standard, pro, and enterprise tiers.
- [Educational Articles](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/blog): In-depth articles covering pedagogy, cognitive science in learning, and exam techniques.
- [Help & Inquiries](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/contact): Customer support and campus location contacts.

## Inspiration & Pedagogical Toolkits

- [Teacher Toolkit](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/inspiration?tab=teacher): Fast-start classroom essentials, formative assessment strategies, differentiated instruction guides, and mastery trackers.
- [Administrator Resource Center](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/inspiration?tab=admin): Institutional leadership blueprints, curriculum mapping protocols, staff development frameworks, and parent engagement metrics.
- [Implementation Strategies](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/inspiration?tab=implementation): Step-by-step rollout roadmaps, cohort scaffolding guides, and continuous feedback loop templates.
- [Parent Collaboration Guides](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/inspiration?tab=parent): Home-school synchronization tools, growth mindset prompts, and academic milestone checklists.

## Multi-User Portal Ecosystem

- [Student Workspace](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/dashboard): Student planner, AI homework helper, badge achievements, and official certificate issuance.
- [Teacher Workspace](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/teacher): Class gradebooks, live webinar conferencing, assignment builder, and lesson plan repository.
- [Parent Portal](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/parent): Automated child activity feeds, behavioral remarks, and parent-teacher meeting scheduling.
- [Administration & ERP](https://ejazbukharimethod.com/admin): Institutional ledger, student directory, fee payment reconciliation, and curriculum publishing.
